name: snap_camera_kit
summary: Snap Camera Kit Lens connector — the AR camera surface. Opens Snapchat's AR Lens via deeplink (snapchat://camera?lens=<id>&hint=<persona>) or wrapped iframe; the user sees their camera + the lens overlay. From our backend we manage: lens metadata, Lens Studio publish bridge (subprocess lenstudio-cli), per-viewer lens routing (one lens variant per identity_resolver persona), and event-pickup when a user records / shares / swipes a snap with the lens applied. Stdlib-only (urllib for HTTPS, subprocess for the optional lenstudio-cli probe). Every record_lens_event crystal-anchors via inference_logger.log with tier='social_event', model='snap_camera_kit', scope='snap_lens_event' — viewer_persona_id is folded into source_file so per-persona engagement is queryable.
engine_pattern: ThirdPartyConnector subclass mirroring stripe_mcp + deepseek_mcp shape exactly. SERVICE='snap_camera_kit'. Tool dispatch via send(recipient=tool_name, message=json_args). connect() does no remote call (deeplink + record_lens_event work without keys); list_lenses + publish_lens degrade gracefully when key/CLI missing — stub return on no API key, 404 'lenstudio_cli_not_found' when binary not on PATH.

env_vars.SNAP_LENS_GROUP_ID: Snap Camera Kit Lens Group ID (required for list_lenses + publish_lens)
env_vars.SNAP_LENS_API_KEY: Snap Camera Kit API key (Bearer auth for kit.snapchat.com/v1/*)
env_vars.LENSSTUDIO_CLI_PATH: (optional) absolute path to lenstudio-cli binary; falls back to which('lenstudio-cli')

lenstudio_cli_install: Download Lens Studio from https://ar.snap.com/download (macOS/Win desktop). The lenstudio-cli binary is bundled in the app's resources dir; symlink it into PATH or set LENSSTUDIO_CLI_PATH to its absolute path.
convenience_wrappers: publish_lens(lens_json_path, group_id) — subprocess lenstudio-cli publish (404 when CLI not on PATH)
record_lens_event(lens_id, viewer_id, event_kind, payload) — receipt + crystal anchor
verify_credentials() — keys-present + CLI-present check, no remote call
substrate: studio/third_party/snap_camera_kit/ + ~/.cc/third_party_logs/snap_camera_kit_sends.jsonl + ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (crystal-anchored social_event records — viewer_persona_id in source_file for per-persona engagement queries)

inbound_callers: identity_resolver (per-persona lens routing → lens_deeplink_url with viewer_persona_id)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: SNAP_LENS_GROUP_ID + SNAP_LENS_API_KEY via studio/auth/keys.load_env; LENSSTUDIO_CLI_PATH from env
routing_connections.substrate_writes: send_log entries + crystal_chain social_event records (source_file folds lens_id|persona|viewer for queryability)

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.connect: ok — connect() returns True without keys (deeplink + record_lens_event work in stub mode)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.record_lens_event: ok — lens_opened event accepted, crystal-anchored, returned crystal=0a82a77aef5933e8...

guarantees: Crystal-anchored — every record_lens_event call has a deterministic InferenceRecord with tier='social_event', model='snap_camera_kit', scope='snap_lens_event'
Per-persona queryable — viewer_persona_id folded into source_file as 'snap:<lens>|persona:<id>|viewer:<id>' for downstream engagement aggregation
Stdlib-only — no Snap SDK; urllib for HTTPS, subprocess for lenstudio-cli probe
Graceful degrade — no SNAP_LENS_API_KEY → list_lenses returns stub; no lenstudio-cli → publish_lens returns SendResult(success=False, error='lenstudio_cli_not_found')
Deeplink is offline — lens_deeplink_url makes no HTTP call (pure URL construction)
Event-kind validated — record_lens_event rejects unknown event_kind with 400 + expected list
Same connector shape as stripe_mcp / deepseek_mcp — uniform third_party pattern
usage_example:
import json
from core.lib.third_party.snap_camera_kit import SnapCameraKitConnector
c = SnapCameraKitConnector()
c.connect()
link = c.send('lens_deeplink_url', json.dumps({'lens_id':'lens_abc','viewer_persona_id':'persona_realtor_v1'})).message_preview
recv = c.send('record_lens_event', json.dumps({'lens_id':'lens_abc','viewer_id':'viewer_xyz','event_kind':'snap_recorded','payload':{'utm':'fb_post'}}))
print(link, recv.crystal_id[:16])
